🔥 The fire settles. Cheyenne has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Maeve says "The fire feels smaller now." David says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A person, maybe 30s speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Cheyenne speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Cheyenne speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Jesse.
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🥣 Ibrahim of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
📓 Codex: Ibrahim of The Red Table begs food at Haven's fire.
Ibrahim waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.
With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 6,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

⛓️ Mateo brings it home: The Red Table bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
